title: Switch the preference-based round-robin ticket assignment ordering from ascendin
description:
When a user creates a ticket from the Create Ticket transaction, the ticket must be automatically assigned to an agent based on the agent’s Preference.

If multiple agents share the same preference, the tickets must be distributed among them in a round-robin manner, following the ascending order of the agents as listed in Agent Master:

The first ticket is assigned to the first agent.
The second ticket is assigned to the second agent.
The third ticket is assigned to the third agent.
The fourth ticket is assigned to the first agent again, and the cycle continues in the same order.
